clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, the Drag links the Valley of Strength, Valley of Honor and Valley of Wisdom. Crafters and traders line its shaded red-rock canyon, where the descent to the Cleft of Shadow also lies.

The Drag runs between Orgrimmar’s red canyon walls, where crafters and traders fill the Horde capital’s streets. Unlike the Valley of Strength, with its military musters and commands, the Drag is where daily city life unfolds. High cliffs and hides shade the street, where tanning vats, alchemical cauldrons and tinkers’ gears fill the air with their sounds and smells. Craftsmen gather to practice their trades and teach aspiring adventurers. Their work ranges from leatherworking and tailoring to the goblin workshops of Nogg’s Machine Shop.

Merchant storefronts and salvage houses line the Drag, beside the guarded entrance to the underground Cleft of Shadow. The street brings honest tradesmen together with shamans on their way to the Valley of Wisdom and secretive practitioners of dark arts. They cross paths beneath the canyon’s dim, dusty overhangs.
